description: Single-thread pyvine-TLL fit at d=500 (data seed 7) in the thread sweep. The sweep saved its last d=200 result and printed the d=500 header at fit_started (both files were last written in that second); the fit had not returned when the sweep job reached its 16-hour time limit and the scheduler ended the job (state TIMEOUT) at job_ended. Times are local (US Eastern).
evidence: modification times of the sweep's result JSON and run log, and the scheduler accounting record of the sweep job
